english.title: Path of Defense
english.detail:
As a warrior, one of our most crucial tasks is... protection.  We are the shield of the Horde, and we keep our weaker brethren safe.  If you are to join in our ranks, then you must prove your mettle to me.

Go to Thunder Ridge in Durotar, where live the lightning hides and thunder lizards.  Hunt the beasts!  Show me you are tougher than they!  Brave their assaults and bring me a stack of their singed scales as proof.

Do this, and then I will teach you.
english.objective: Bring 5 Singed Scales to Uzzek at Far Watch Post in the Barrens.
english.progress: Do you have the scales, <name>?  Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.
english.complete:
Ah.  I see you have defeated the thunder lizards, which proves you are tough.  Now I will show you how tough skin and shrewd movements can combine to form an impenetrable wall of defense.

Learn your lesson well, <name>.  And be ready for future instruction.

english.title: Thun'grim Firegaze
english.detail:
It is vital that a warrior's weapon is one of quality.  And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze.  He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.

If you seek a weapon, warrior, then you should seek Thun'grim.  To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills.  His camp is high on a hilltop.
english.objective: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
english.complete:
My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame,  but some things I can still see.  I can see you want something.

And if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.

english.title: Forged Steel
english.detail:
I will give you a weapon, <name>, but first you must aid me.  The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past.  They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me!  The cowards!

They took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars.  If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.

Search for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
english.objective: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
english.progress: Do you have my steel bars?
english.complete:
You found them!  And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me.  I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.

Thank you, <name>.  Here is your reward.  May it serve you well.

english.title: Veteran Uzzek
english.detail:
The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned.  But the truly great warriors are great students as well.

Seek out Uzzek.  He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat.  You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the Barrens and Durotar to the east.
english.objective: Speak with Uzzek at Far Watch Post.
english.complete: Hello, young one.  Here for some instruction, are you?

english.title: A Warrior's Training
english.detail:
You've shown yourself to be a competent warrior, <name>.  But you're still young and have a lot to learn.

Speak with Harry Burlguard--he's usually in the Pig and Whistle tavern, in the Old Town of Stormwind.  Harry is an old veteran and a good teacher.  He can show you a few moves that'll keep you breathing longer.
english.objective: Speak with Harry Burlguard.
english.complete:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lad.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?

english.title: Marshal Haggard
english.detail:
You've learned a few moves, but you could still use a decent weapon.  I bet if you spoke with Marshal Haggard he could help you.

Marshal Haggard lives in a manor in Elwynn Forest, at the Eastvale Lumber Camp.  He's retired now but he collected a lot of gear during his career.

Let him know I sent you, and with luck he'll have a spare weapon to offer.

english.title: Dead-tooth Jack
english.detail:
Burlguard sent you, did he?  Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...

A while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth Jack tricked me.  It was dark and he was wearing a Stormwind tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan.  He said he needed my old Stormwind Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... and then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!

Get back my badge!  Dead-tooth Jack probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.
english.objective: Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
english.progress: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
english.complete:
Great, you found it!  I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a Stormwind official.  Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.

Here are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal.  I kept them in great shape--take your pick!

english.title: Vejrek
english.detail:
If you want to rise in the ranks of the warriors, then you better be tough.  I can teach you new moves but before that, prove to me you can handle yourself against real foes.

Vejrek is the toughest troll you'll find in these parts, and he's who you have to beat.  He has a hut in the foothills just south of Frostmane Hold

Bring me Vejrek's head and I'll know you have mettle.
english.objective: Bring Vejrek's Head to Muren Stormpike in Ironforge.
english.progress: Have you been to Vejrek's hut, <name>?  Is that troll stink I smell on you?
english.complete:
Vejrek sure was an ugly one, eh?  Nicely done, <name>!  You have what it takes, now let's start your lesson...

You may not know it, but a strong defense is very important to a <class>.  It keeps him standing against foes that'd fell others, and that's what your allies need.

english.title: Muren Stormpike
english.detail:
Hello, warrior!  You show a lot of promise, but you still need to learn some tricks and Muren Stormpike is just the dwarf to teach you.

You can find Muren at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward of Ironforge.  Talk to him when you're ready to learn what it is to be a warrior.

english.title: Ironband's Compound
english.detail:
My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh.  There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

But one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore.  Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... a band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound.  They killed everyone!

Enter Ironband's compound, <name>, and avenge my master's death.  And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.
english.objective: Bring a load of Umbral Ore to Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge.
english.progress: Have you entered Ironband's Compound?  Did you find the umbral ore?
english.complete:
You found it! Well done!

I hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching.  I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.

But thank you for the ore, <name>.  I'm eager to work it and find its properties.

english.title: Vorlus Vilehoof
english.detail:
Before I can teach you, you must show me your resolve.

The satyr Vorlus Vilehoof has found one of our remote moonwells, southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  He now splashes within it, defiling its pure waters with his filth.

Find Vorlus at the moonwell and destroy him.  Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a warrior.

The path to the moonwell is hidden well, <name>, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.
english.objective: Bring the Horn of Vorlus to Elanaria in Darnassus.
english.progress: Do you have the horn, <name>?  Is our moonwell free of the fiend Vorlus?
english.complete:
Well done, <name>.  It is good to know Vorlus is defeated and our moonwell cleansed, and it is good to see young warriors eager to keep our beloved Teldrassil free of corruption.

Now let us begin your training...

english.title: The Shade of Elura
english.detail:
You have learned much, <name>.  Now we will craft you a weapon.  A warrior's weapon.

To do this, you must travel to Darkshore.

Long ago a ship crashed upon the rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse, scattering many crates of elunite ore along the ocean floor.

First, you must defeat the elunite's guardian, the Shade of Elura.  Once the ship's captain, she cursed herself to roam the deeps and protect her shipment for all time.  Defeat her, gain her medallion, and gather the crates of lost Elunite.
english.objective: Bring 8 loads of Elunite Ore and the Medallion of Elura to Elanaria in Darnassus.
english.progress: Have you defeated the Shade of Elura, <name>?  And do you have the lost elunite ore?
english.complete:
Bravely done, <name>.

You have given the Shade of Elura much deserved peace, and we will use the gathered elunite to make a fine weapon for you.

Mathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.
